shop-S01-accounts-lost.last_sql:
WITH ref AS (SELECT max(opened_at) AS t FROM shop.repair_order),
o AS (
  SELECT customer_id, opened_at
  FROM shop.repair_order
  WHERE status <> 'void'
)
SELECT c.name AS account_name,
       to_char(max(o.opened_at),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS last_order_on_yyyy_mm_dd,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.opened_at >= (SELECT t FROM ref) - interval '30 days') AS orders_last_30_days_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.opened_at >= (SELECT t FROM ref) - interval '180 days'
                          AND o.opened_at <  (SELECT t FROM ref) - interval '150 days') AS orders_180_to_150_days_ago_count
FROM shop.customer c
JOIN o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.kind = 'company'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.opened_at >= (SELECT t FROM ref) - interval '30 days') = 0
   AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.opened_at >= (SELECT t FROM ref) - interval '180 days'
                          AND o.opened_at <  (SELECT t FROM ref) - interval '150 days') > 0
ORDER BY orders_180_to_150_days_ago_count DESC, last_order_on_yyyy_mm_dd DESC

shop-S11-seasonal-hire-start.last_sql:

  FROM shop.employee
  WHERE title = 'Seasonal Shop Helper'
)

       to_char(hired_on,'YYYY-MM') AS season_start_month_yyyy_mm,

shop-S15-average-order-by-shop.last_sql:
SELECT l.name AS shop_name,
       ROUND(AVG(r.total - r.tax_total), 2) AS average_order_before_tax_usd,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(r.total - r.tax_total), 2) AS rev
FROM shop.repair_order r
JOIN shop.location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id
WHERE r.status <> 'void'
  AND r.order_type = 'customer_pay'

shop-top-jobs-90d.last_sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT repair_order_id, min(changed_at) AS invoiced_at
  FROM shop.order_status_history WHERE status='invoiced' GROUP BY 1),
elig AS (
  SELECT ro.repair_order_id, ro.total-ro.tax_total AS net
  FROM shop.repair_order ro JOIN inv ON inv.repair_order_id=ro.repair_order_id
  WHERE ro.order_type='customer_pay' AND ro.status IN ('invoiced','paid')
    AND inv.invoiced_at >= now() - interval '90 days' AND inv.invoiced_at < now()),
jl AS (
  SELECT oj.order_job_id, oj.repair_order_id,
    coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM shop.order_labor ol WHERE ol.order_job_id=oj.order_job_id),0)
   + coalesce((SELECT sum(op.quantity*op.unit_price) FROM shop.order_part op WHERE op.order_job_id=oj.order_job_id),0)
   + coalesce((SELECT sum(os.price) FROM shop.order_sublet os WHERE os.order_job_id=oj.order_job_id),0) AS job_value
  FROM shop.order_job oj JOIN elig e ON e.repair_order_id=oj.repair_order_id
  WHERE oj.status='approved'),
w AS (SELECT jl.*, sum(job_value) OVER (PARTITION BY repair_order_id) AS order_value FROM jl)
SELECT round(sum(e.net * CASE WHEN w.order_value>0 THEN w.job_value/w.order_value ELSE 0 END),2) AS allocated,
       count(*) AS jobs, count(DISTINCT w.repair_order_id) AS orders_with_jobs
FROM w JOIN elig e ON e.repair_order_id=w.repair_order_id

shop-cars-per-day.last_sql:
with d as (
  select l.name, o.opened_at::date as day, count(*) as visits, count(distinct o.vehicle_id) as cars
  from shop.repair_order o join shop.location l using (location_id)
  where o.status <> 'void' and extract(isodow from o.opened_at) between 1 and 5
  group by 1,2
)
select name,
  count(*) as weekday_days,
  sum(visits) as total_visits,
  round(sum(visits)::numeric / count(*), 2) as avg_visits_per_weekday,
  round(sum(cars)::numeric / count(*), 2) as avg_cars_per_weekday
from d group by 1 order by 1

shop-busiest-weekday.last_sql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT d::date AS d, EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d)::int AS dow
  FROM (SELECT min(opened_at::date) mn, max(opened_at::date) mx FROM shop.repair_order WHERE status<>'void') s,
       generate_series(s.mn, s.mx, interval '1 day') d
), per_date AS (
  SELECT opened_at::date AS d, count(*)::numeric c
  FROM shop.repair_order WHERE status <> 'void' GROUP BY 1
), agg AS (
  SELECT days.dow, count(*) AS n_days, sum(coalesce(per_date.c,0)) AS orders
  FROM days LEFT JOIN per_date ON per_date.d = days.d GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT dow AS weekday_iso_1_7, round(orders/n_days, 2) AS orders_per_day_avg
FROM agg ORDER BY orders_per_day_avg DESC LIMIT 1

shop-new-vs-returning-this-month.last_sql:
WITH month_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM shop.repair_order
  WHERE status <> 'void' AND opened_at >= '2026-11-01' AND opened_at < '2026-12-01' AND customer_id <> 5511
)
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop.repair_order p WHERE p.customer_id=mc.customer_id AND p.status<>'void' AND p.opened_at < '2026-11-01')) AS returning,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop.repair_order p WHERE p.customer_id=mc.customer_id AND p.status<>'void' AND p.opened_at < '2026-11-01')) AS new
FROM month_cust mc

shop-parts-waiting.last_sql:
WITH wp AS (
  SELECT ro.repair_order_id, ro.location_id, ro.vehicle_id,
         (SELECT max(h.changed_at) FROM shop.order_status_history h
          WHERE h.repair_order_id = ro.repair_order_id AND h.status='waiting_parts') AS entered_waiting_parts
  FROM shop.repair_order ro
  WHERE ro.status = 'waiting_parts' AND ro.status <> 'void'
)
SELECT l.name AS shop_name,
       COUNT(*) AS cars_waiting_count,
       MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE l.time_zone) - wp.entered_waiting_parts))/86400.0) AS longest_wait_days
FROM wp
JOIN shop.location l ON l.location_id = wp.location_id
GROUP BY l.name, l.location_id
ORDER BY l.location_id;

shop-parts-margin-last-month.last_sql:
with inv as (
  select repair_order_id, min(changed_at) as first_inv
  from shop.order_status_history where status='invoiced' group by repair_order_id
),
lines as (
  select oj.repair_order_id,
         sum(op.quantity*op.unit_price) as line_sales,
         sum(op.quantity*op.unit_cost) as line_cost
  from shop.order_job oj join shop.order_part op on op.order_job_id=oj.order_job_id
  where oj.status='approved'
  group by oj.repair_order_id
),
agg as (
  select l.name as shop_name,
         sum(ro.parts_total) as gross,
         sum(case when (ro.labor_total+ro.parts_total+ro.sublet_total+ro.fees_total)>0
             then ro.discount_total * ro.parts_total/(ro.labor_total+ro.parts_total+ro.sublet_total+ro.fees_total)
             else 0 end) as disc_alloc,
         sum(ln.line_cost) as cost
  from shop.repair_order ro
  join inv on inv.repair_order_id=ro.repair_order_id
  join shop.location l on l.location_id=ro.location_id
  left join lines ln on ln.repair_order_id=ro.repair_order_id
  where ro.order_type='customer_pay' and ro.status in ('invoiced','paid')
    and inv.first_inv >= '2026-10-01' and inv.first_inv < '2026-11-01'
  group by l.name
)
select shop_name,
       round(gross-disc_alloc,2) as parts_sales_before_tax_usd,
       round((gross-disc_alloc-cost)/(gross-disc_alloc),4) as parts_margin_float_0_1,
       round(cost,2) as cost_check,
       round((gross-cost)/gross,4) as margin_gross_discount
from agg order by shop_name

shop-mechanic-billed-hours.last_sql:

from shop.repair_order ro
join shop.order_status_history osh on osh.repair_order_id=ro.repair_order_id and osh.status='invoiced'

shop-recommended-sold-by-advisor.last_sql:
with rec as (
  select oj.order_job_id, oj.repair_order_id, oj.status
  from shop.order_job oj
  join (select distinct order_job_id from shop.inspection_item where order_job_id is not null) ii
    on ii.order_job_id = oj.order_job_id
)
select e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name as advisor_name,
       count(*)::int as recommended_jobs_count,
       round((count(*) filter (where r.status='approved'))::numeric
             / nullif(count(*) filter (where r.status in ('approved','declined')),0), 4)::float8 as sold_share_float_0_1
from rec r
join shop.repair_order ro on ro.repair_order_id = r.repair_order_id
join shop.location l on l.location_id = ro.location_id
join shop.employee e on e.employee_id = ro.advisor_id
where ro.status <> 'void'
  and (ro.opened_at at time zone l.time_zone) >= now() - interval '90 days'
group by e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
having count(*) > 0
order by advisor_name

shop-tech-efficiency-this-month.last_sql:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT ol.technician_id AS tech_id, sum(ol.hours) AS sold_hours
  FROM shop.order_labor ol
  JOIN shop.order_job oj ON oj.order_job_id = ol.order_job_id
  JOIN shop.repair_order ro ON ro.repair_order_id = oj.repair_order_id
  WHERE ol.technician_id IS NOT NULL
    AND oj.status = 'approved'
    AND ro.status <> 'void'
    AND ro.opened_at >= DATE '2026-11-01' AND ro.opened_at < DATE '2026-12-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), clocked AS (
  SELECT te.technician_id AS tech_id,
         sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (te.clock_out - te.clock_in))/3600.0) AS clocked_hours
  FROM shop.time_entry te
  WHERE te.clock_out IS NOT NULL
    AND te.clock_in >= DATE '2026-11-01' AND te.clock_in < DATE '2026-12-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS technician_name,
       round(coalesce(s.sold_hours,0), 2) AS sold_hours,
       round(coalesce(c.clocked_hours,0), 2) AS clocked_hours,
       round(coalesce(s.sold_hours,0) / nullif(c.clocked_hours,0), 2) AS sold_over_clocked_float
FROM clocked c
LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.tech_id = c.tech_id
JOIN shop.employee e ON e.employee_id = c.tech_id
ORDER BY sold_over_clocked_float DESC

shop-comebacks-by-mechanic.last_sql:
with worked as (
  select ol.technician_id, oj.repair_order_id
  from shop.order_labor ol
  join shop.order_job oj on oj.order_job_id = ol.order_job_id
  join shop.repair_order ro on ro.repair_order_id = oj.repair_order_id
  where oj.status = 'approved' and ro.status <> 'void' and ol.technician_id is not null
    and ro.opened_at >= current_date - interval '1 year'
), per_tech as (select technician_id, count(distinct repair_order_id) as n from worked group by 1),
cb as (select distinct c.repair_order_id, ol.technician_id from shop.repair_order c
  join shop.order_job oj on oj.repair_order_id=c.comeback_of_id
  join shop.order_labor ol on ol.order_job_id=oj.order_job_id
  where c.comeback_of_id is not null and c.status<>'void' and c.opened_at >= current_date - interval '1 year' and ol.technician_id is not null),
cb_agg as (select technician_id, count(*) as k from cb group by 1)
select e.first_name||' '||e.last_name as technician_name, p.n, coalesce(k,0) as comebacks,
       round(coalesce(k,0)::numeric/nullif(p.n,0),4)::float8 as share
from per_tech p join shop.employee e on e.employee_id=p.technician_id left join cb_agg c on c.technician_id=p.technician_id
order by comebacks desc, share desc limit 5

shop-accounts-owed.last_sql:
with accts as (
  select customer_id, name from shop.customer where payment_terms_days is not null
), owed as (
  select o.customer_id, sum(o.total) owed_usd,
         sum(case when s.statement_id is not null and s.due_on < current_date and o.statement_id is not null then o.total else 0 end) overdue_on_stmt
  from shop.repair_order o
  left join shop.statement s on s.statement_id = o.statement_id
  where o.status = 'invoiced' and o.order_type = 'customer_pay' and o.customer_id in (select customer_id from accts)
  group by 1
), ovd as (
  select s.customer_id, sum(s.total - coalesce(p.paid,0)) overdue_usd
  from shop.statement s
  left join (select statement_id, sum(case when kind='refund' then -amount else amount end) paid from shop.payment where statement_id is not null group by 1) p on p.statement_id=s.statement_id
  where s.status <> 'paid' and s.due_on < current_date
  group by 1
), dps as (
  select s.customer_id, avg((p.received_at::date - s.issued_on)) avg_days, count(*) n
  from shop.statement s join shop.payment p on p.statement_id = s.statement_id
  where p.received_at >= now() - interval '6 months'
  group by 1
)
select a.name as account_name,
       round(coalesce(o.owed_usd,0),2) as owed_usd,
       round(coalesce(v.overdue_usd,0),2) as overdue_usd,
       round(coalesce(d.avg_days,0),1) as days_to_pay_avg
from accts a
left join owed o on o.customer_id=a.customer_id
left join ovd v on v.customer_id=a.customer_id
left join dps d on d.customer_id=a.customer_id
order by a.name

shop-discounts-this-month.last_sql:

       count(*) AS discounted_orders_count,
       ROUND(sum(ro.discount_total),2) AS discounts_before_tax_usd
FROM shop.repair_order ro
JOIN shop.location l ON l.location_id = ro.location_id
WHERE ro.opened_at >= '2026-11-01' AND ro.opened_at < '2026-12-01'
